name: EmuDrop
summary: Browses third-party sources and downloads ROM files and artwork.

notes: WARNING: ROM downloads can infringe copyright. Users must confirm that each download is lawful in their jurisdiction and that they have the required rights.
Installation is blocked: the tagged source has no license or redistribution grant.
The bundled launch-time updater disables TLS verification and replaces executable code outside app-manager checksum, path, backup, and rollback controls.
Community approval permits catalogue inclusion but is not a real-device package verification.

evidence.note: Version-pinned Knulli ZIP; 18,009,624 bytes compressed, 41,370,114 bytes extracted, SHA-256 02fe1fe562a7f7991e45940d95b1f3d4af023c371be62c1ae79b1bb75203f799.
No license, COPYING file, SPDX header, or explicit redistribution grant was found at this tag commit.
Upstream names TrimUI Smart Pro with Knulli and provides Knulli paths, but provides no linked real-device test report or minimum Knulli version.

Reviewed paths include /userdata/roms/pygame/EmuDropKnulli and broad writes below /userdata/roms for ROMs, images, and gamelist.xml files. Network access is required. The local launcher invokes an updater that downloads replacement code with TLS verification disabled.
